name: polyblue
description: Cross-platform simultaneous multi-device Bluetooth manager with zero-drift audio sync engine for Windows, Linux, and macOS.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n daemon,ui -c cyan,green "npm run dev:daemon" "npm run dev:ui"
scripts.build: npm --workspace=@polyblue/shared run build && npm --workspace=@polyblue/daemon run build && npm --workspace=@polyblue/cli run build && npm --workspace=@polyblue/ui run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@polyblue/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=@polyblue/daemon run typecheck && npm --workspace=@polyblue/cli run typecheck && npm --workspace=@polyblue/ui run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace=@polyblue/shared run test && npm --workspace=@polyblue/daemon run test
